caption: This drawing depicts a rectangular decorative panel with a symmetrical, floral pattern. The background color is teal, and the design features red, white, green, yellow, and black elements. Floral motifs, including stylized flowers and leaves, are arranged around the border and inside the central field. The outermost border is teal with corner petal shapes, surrounded by a red stripe and then an inner floral border containing alternating red, green, and yellow flower shapes with white accents and leafy vines. Inside the central area, there are larger stylized flowers, primarily red with white and black highlights, and green and black leaves with white accents, radiating from the bottom center. In the upper middle part of the composition is a rectangular, metallic-colored lock plate with a visible keyhole, bordered with round stud details and an attached latch. Two horizontal metallic-colored bands with circular rivets run across the shorter sides of the rectangle, intersecting the floral border near the upper left and lower right corners. The entire panel is symmetrical and precisely divided, with all elements carefully balanced in color and placement.
title: Painted Chest
